headline: Nigerian Naira Drops 2.5% to 1,400 Per Dollar Despite $1.3 Billion CBN Sale
summary: The Nigerian naira depreciated 2.50% to touch 1,400 per US dollar despite the Central Bank of Nigeria selling $1.30 billion into the interbank foreign exchange market.
why: The naira exchange rate directly dictates import inflation, corporate profitability, and sovereign borrowing costs in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Interbank FX demand surged nearly twelvefold, pressing the naira 2.5% lower to N1,400/$.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Interbank FX demand expanded twelvefold during the week, overwhelming central bank dollar supply.
